mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 4.0% signals an easing monetary policy cycle, which reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%, or the IC < 0.03 over any 2-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% triggers a contraction in labor demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses above 5.0%, or the IC < 0.03 over the 5-day window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in GDP (GDPC1) and demand for goods (HOUST) above their 2023 averages signals a robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both GDPC1 and HOUST are above their 2023 averages, or the IC < 0.03 over the 20-day window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising), elevated discount rates on equity cash flows reduce expected returns, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive despite FEDFUNDS above 4.5% in the tightening cycle, or the IC < 0.03 over the 60-day window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 113.9 (2023 average) indicates expanding supply chains, which enhances corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when INDPRO exceeds 113.9, or the IC < 0.03 over the 60-day window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110 signals supply-side contraction, reducing corporate margins and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns within the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite INDPRO falling below 110, or the IC > 0.05 over the 20-day window.

mechanism_narrative: High job growth (PAYEMS) combined with rising unemployment (UNRATE) creates labor market stress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when both PAYEMS and UNRATE are at or above their recent peaks, or the IC < 0.03 over the 20-day window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 and HOUST both above 2023 averages), sustained demand growth supports equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain negative despite GDPC1 and HOUST above 2023 averages, or the IC < 0.03 over the 60-day window.
